Remote Control Agent v0.1.48 extends the existing owner-approved Windows/Linux Agent upgrade path to support explicit detached execution initiated via Remote Control Shell. It does not add a new MCP tool, service, pairing protocol, or an automatic updater.

- **Linux**: explicit `rca upgrade --unattended` launches a bounded, independent owner-user systemd unit. Only the existing paired, owner-ON Agent can request this; it reuses reviewed Release pins, operation freeze, rollback, and identity receipts.
- **Windows**: the reviewed official pinned installer supports opt-in creation of a demand-start, one-shot, limited same-user upgrade task. It protects the original Owner Task, identity, immutable source and Release checksum, and refuses unsafe or ambiguous upgrades. Existing interactive installer remains available.
- **Safety**: named-pipe identity normalized consistently for native Node and PowerShell, with exact native Windows IPC and owner-stop/rollback checks. A detached launcher acknowledgement is not success: independently confirm the resumed signed WSS, device ID, Agent version and historical operation receipts.

Release artifacts are the same three independently built/reviewed native targets: Linux x64/ARM64 and Windows x64. macOS remains an unpublished candidate and is not supported by this Release. No paired device is automatically upgraded by publication.
